description:
Quick notes and checklists that sync with your own memos server Capynib is a quick notes app in the style of Google Keep: colored cards, checklists you can tick, pinned notes and an archive. Your notes stay on your phone. Everything you write is saved on the device first and works fully offline. No account is needed. Sync with your own server. If you run a memos server, sign in with an access token or through the browser and every change syncs about a second after you type. Edits made in the memos web app or on another device come back to the phone. When both sides changed a note, both versions are kept, so nothing you typed is lost. Each note is one private memo: its title is the memo's first-line heading and its color a tag at the end, so notes read naturally in the memos web app too.
  • Notes with a title, a body and a color
  • Checklists with items you can tick
  • Photos in a note, taken with the camera or chosen from the phone, shown on its card
  • Voice recordings in a note, played from the note or its card
  • Pinning, archive and search
  • Tags: write #tag in a note, then pick it to see only those notes
  • A trash that keeps deleted notes for a week, or as many days as you set
  • Long press to pick several notes, drag to reorder, swipe to archive or pin
  • Quick capture from a home screen widget, launcher shortcuts, a Quick Settings tile or Share
  • Sync with a self-hosted memos server, offline until the server is back
